title: Restriction of fppf sheafification to the affine site
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $F$ be a presheaf on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site]. Write $u:(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}\to(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ for the inclusion. Then the restriction of the fppf sheafification $F^{\#}$ along $u$ is canonically and functorially isomorphic to the fppf sheafification $(F|_{(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}})^{\#}$ on the affine fppf site.

source.place: Tag 021V, Lemma 34.7.11 (equivalence of the big and affine fppf topoi)
